sum: Air Products and Chemicals, Inc., an industrial gases company, provides industrial gases, related equipment, and applications to the energy, environmental, and other markets in the Americas, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, India, and internationally. The company produces and sells atmospheric gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, and argon; process gases, such as hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, and syngas; and specialty gases through on-site gases supply mode or merchant gases supply mode. It also designs, manufactures, and sells equipment for air separation, hydrocarbon recovery and purification, and liquid helium and liquid hydrogen transport and storage; manufactures turboexpanders and other precision rotating equipment; and fabricates helium and hydrogen transport and storage containers. In addition, the company provides cryogenic nitrogen plant, on-site gas generation, cryogenic oxygen plant, PSA hydrogen purification, and membrane separators and systems; and develops, engineers, builds, owns, and operates some of the hydrogen projects, as well as provides air products express services, industrial gas plant services, syngas solutions, and air products smart technology. It serves materials processing, aerospace, analytical labs and research/science, automotive, beverages, bioenergy, biotechnology, cement and lime, chemicals, electronics, food, glass and frit, hydrogen fuelling, industrial decarbonization, lifting, medical, metals production, oil and gas production, oil refining, pharmaceuticals, power, pulp and paper, rubber and plastics, water and wastewater, and welding and cutting industries. Air Products and Chemicals, Inc. was founded in 1940 and is headquartered in Allentown, Pennsylvania.
